bad_config: Invalid value {{value}} of setting {{field}}, the default is used
category_conflict: Collectors disagree on what this is: it was classified as “$t(category.{{winner}})”, but it may also be “$t(category.{{loser}})”. Check it before deciding not to save it
bad_number: Invalid number {{value}} in field {{field}} of a finding, it is treated as 0
no_evidence: A finding came without any explanation of why it was found; it is rated with low confidence
sensitive_selected: Passwords, keys or other sensitive data are selected for the backup (findings: {{count}}). Consider encrypting the backup

tag.nested: Inside another finding: it is saved together with it
tag.alternative: Another way to save the data of the parent finding: not selected by default
tag.restorable: Cache or reinstallable files: they are restored without a backup
tag.needs_elevation: Needs administrator rights: restart SaveKeeper as administrator to save it
tag.too_large_default: Too large to be selected by default: select it manually if you need it
tag.below_threshold: Not important enough, or too large for an unrecognized item, to be selected by default
tag.conflict: Collectors disagree on the category: check whether it needs to be saved
tag.unmeasured: The size was not measured, the score is approximate
